reasons.wild-ride-blue: Provides a vital blue pitch card that draws and discards upon attacking, easily satisfying Kayo's Might generation and granting Mandible Claw go again.
reasons.bare-fangs-blue: Supplies needed blue pitch while providing another built-in draw-and-discard attack to trigger Kayo's passive Might token creation.
reasons.savage-feast-blue: Functions as a high-resource pitch card that discards a card as an additional cost to trigger Kayo and replaces itself by drawing a card.
reasons.buckwild-red: Serves as a high-damage red threat that easily gains go again thanks to the high density of 6-or-more power cards in your pitch zone.
reasons.mighty-windup-yellow: Gets boosted to 6 power in your hand by Kayo, meaning its instant-speed discard triggers Kayo to generate a second Might token alongside its own.
reasons.mighty-windup-red: Can be discarded as an instant during your action phase to generate a Might token and immediately trigger Kayo for a second Might token.
reasons.agile-windup-yellow: Counts as a 6-power card in hand under Kayo, allowing its instant discard to create an Agility token while triggering Kayo for a Might token.
reasons.agile-windup-red: Offers an on-demand instant discard to grant Agility for subsequent go again while triggering Kayo's once-per-turn Might creation.
reasons.savage-feast-yellow: Adds another attack that discards a card to reliably trigger Kayo and draws a card when attacking to maintain hand size.
reasons.buzzard-helm: Offers valuable equipment defense while filtering your hand and enabling defensive-turn discards to set up your graveyard.
